name: shc_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for Soil Health Card authentication. Does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile not registered.

name: shc_verify_otp
description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for SHC operations. Does NOT check soil reports or sample status. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated.

name: shc_register_soil_sample
description: Registers a new soil sample for testing linked to a specific land parcel. Transitions sample_status to 'registered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT collect or test the sample. Fails if land_parcel_id is invalid, a duplicate sample is already registered for the same parcel in the current cycle, or the farmer is not authenticated.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel.

gps_coordinates.description: GPS coordinates of the sample collection point.

name: shc_track_sample_status
description: Tracks the lifecycle status of a soil sample. Returns sample_status ('registered', 'collected', 'in_transit', 'under_testing', 'tested') with timestamps. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify sample status or generate reports. Fails if sample_id is invalid or does not belong to the authenticated farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_request_soil_test
description: Submits a request for laboratory testing of a collected soil sample. Sample must be in 'collected' or 'in_transit' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate the report or provide nutrient analysis. Fails if sample is still in 'registered' status (not yet collected), or if a test request already exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_generate_soil_health_card
description: Generates the Soil Health Card report for a tested soil sample. Transitions report_status from 'not_generated' to 'generated'. Sample must be in 'tested' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide fertilizer recommendations — use shc_get_fertilizer_recommendation. Fails if testing is not complete, sample_id is invalid, or partial nutrient data exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_get_nutrient_analysis
description: Retrieves detailed nutrient analysis values (N, P, K, pH, organic carbon, micronutrients) from a generated Soil Health Card. Values are lab-measured and CANNOT be modified. Requires session_token. Report must be in 'generated' or 'delivered' status. Does NOT provide recommendations. Fails if report is not generated yet or sample_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

nutrient_type.description: Specific nutrient to query. Allowed: 'nitrogen', 'phosphorus', 'potassium', 'organic_carbon', 'ph', 'micronutrients'. Optional — if omitted, returns all.

name: shc_get_fertilizer_recommendation
description: Generates fertilizer recommendations based on Soil Health Card test results and the intended crop. Recommendations are derived strictly from lab-measured values. Requires session_token. Report must exist. Does NOT apply fertilizers or modify soil data. Fails if no report exists, or crop type is unsupported for the soil type.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_get_soil_improvement_advisory
description: Provides soil improvement advisory based on SHC test results including remediation steps for nutrient deficiencies, pH correction, and organic matter improvement. Requires session_token. Does NOT execute farming actions. Fails if no report exists for the sample.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_get_crop_suitability
description: Returns a list of crops suitable for the farmer's soil based on SHC nutrient analysis. Requires session_token. Report must exist. Does NOT provide fertilizer quantities — use shc_get_fertilizer_recommendation. Fails if no report exists or nutrient data is incomplete.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_get_sample_history
description: Retrieves all historical soil samples and reports for a farmer across all land parcels. SHC reports are typically generated once every 2 years. Requires session_token. Does NOT create new samples. Fails if no samples exist for the farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Optional. Filter by specific land parcel.

name: shc_get_lab_status
description: Returns details about the assigned soil testing laboratory including processing capacity, expected turnaround time, and current queue status. Requires session_token. Does NOT expedite testing. Fails if sample_id is invalid or no lab is assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for a soil sample.

name: shc_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance related to SHC. Valid categories: 'sample_not_collected', 'report_not_generated', 'incorrect_values', 'lab_delay', 'recommendation_issue'. Farmer must check sample/report status first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if category is invalid or duplicate exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: shc_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks a previously raised SHC grievance. Returns resolution status and remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
